subject: Request: Attestation and Supporting Docs for Non-Nexus Tax Status
messages:
From: Sam Rivera <s.rivera@northcoastretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounting Team <acct@northcoastretail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Attestation and W-9 for tax-exempt billing

Hi Hannah,

Following up from our call earlier — please find attached a signed attestation (northcoast_attestation_signed.pdf) and our current W-9 (current_W9.pdf). NorthCoast requests that invoices for purchases of resale inventory be treated as exempt from state sales tax where applicable.

A few quick notes:
- Billing entity: NorthCoast Retail, Inc. (EIN matches W-9).
- We operate as a pure reseller for the SKUs covered by our PO; we do not take title in several fulfillment flow states and are requesting resale treatment where allowed.

Can you confirm what additional documentation your team needs to clear the tax flags on outstanding invoices (particularly invoice #8921)? If there is a template you prefer for attestation wording, please send it and we will re-run on letterhead.

Thanks,
Sam Rivera
Director, Finance Operations
NorthCoast Retail
Attachments: northcoast_attestation_signed.pdf (signed attestation), current_W9.pdf (W-9)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Rivera <s.rivera@northcoastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Attestation and W-9 for tax-exempt billing

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick send and the attachments. Looping in Marissa (billing) and Karthik (legal/tax) so we can confirm acceptance criteria.

A few items we need to accept your attestation and release the tax hold on invoice #8921:
1) State coverage: a list of ship-to states where you claim resale/non-nexus treatment and, where required by state law, a scanned resale certificate for that state (CA, TX, NY and others each have different requirements). A blanket attestation is fine for states that accept it, but for states that require a signed resale certificate we will need the state form.
2) Entity match: the company name on any certificate must exactly match the billing entity on the invoice and the EIN on the W-9.
3) Scope & PO mapping: confirm which invoice line items / POs are resale-eligible (e.g., PO 4321 covers product lines A,B,C).
4) Effective dates: the attestation should include an effective date (or start date of coverage).

Attached is our attestation_template.docx (format we typically accept) — if you can reissue on NorthCoast letterhead with the exact phrasing in section 2 that will speed review. If you cannot provide state forms for certain jurisdictions, please call that out so we can document the gap.

If you can get the rest to us by end of day Tue 1 Sep we can aim to clear the hold for August invoices. If not, Marissa will provide a partial-release plan.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Customer Billing
Redwood Inference
Attachments: attestation_template.docx

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — attaching a quick sample invoice (sample_invoice_8921.pdf) and a shorthand state coverage list in the body below. We can produce state-specific resale certificates where required; where the state accepts a corporate attestation we have included that in northcoast_attestation_signed.pdf.

State coverage (summary):
- OR, MT: no sales tax — not applicable.
- WA, CA: resale accepted with certificate — will provide CA resale cert; WA we have a reseller license and can attach.
- TX, NY: require state forms — will get signed forms for TX and NY by next week.

PO mapping: invoice #8921 maps to PO 4321 and covers product SKUs A2100-A2125.

Let me know if the sample invoice plus the attestation will allow a partial release for shipping-related charges; we can prioritize getting TX/NY forms next week.

Sam

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NorthCoast attestation — recommended acceptance and next steps

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note after reviewing Sam's attachments.

Summary: we have a signed corporate attestation and a W-9; Sam has committed to state-specific resale certificates for TX/NY and indicated WA/CA coverage. Sample invoice included to map POs.

Recommended acceptance criteria:
- Accept the corporate attestation for jurisdictions that accept attestation letters (per our tax team's list).
- Require signed state resale certificates for TX and NY before full release for line items shipped to those states.
- Confirm EIN on W-9 matches billing entity exactly (I verified the W-9 name + EIN match invoice header).

Action items:
- Marissa: please initiate a partial release for invoice #8921 limited to shipments to OR/MT/WA/CA (OR/MT no tax; WA/CA contingent on receipt of reseller license for WA and CA certificate when provided). Hold TX/NY lines until state forms arrive. Please update HubSpot DEAL-5643 with the partial release and expected docs due date (2026-09-08).
- Karthik: quick read of the attestation wording attached — flag any language we should request changed (I think we should ask for explicit "resale of tangible personal property" phrasing in the attestation).

If you both agree I'll reply to Sam with the partial-release plan and the exact wording request for the attestation so they can reissue if needed.

Thanks,
Hannah
Manager, Customer Billing, Redwood Inference
